Verkaufen Sie Ihre digitalen Produkte in diesem Shop

Got digital products of your own — a guide, a template pack, a course, a tool — and no storefront to put them on? Rent a spot on my shelves.

Shop-Verkäuferplatz — $14.50/Monat. Der übliche Preis für ein einfaches Shop-Abonnement anderswo liegt bei $29 im Monat. Meiner kostet die Hälfte, weil Sie einen Platz in einem laufenden Shop mieten und keine ganze Plattform kaufen.

  • Your products shown as proper product cards — your graphics, your titles, your prices — on this store's shelves, in the category they belong in.
  • Every card links straight to your own Gumroad product page. The buyer pays you, at your register. I never touch your money, and I take no cut of your sales — the rent is all I charge.
  • Your spot stays up while your membership is active. Let it lapse and the cards come down.

How it works, plain: you buy the spot, then you send me your product details — title, price, cover picture, a short description, and your Gumroad link for each one. Me and my crew look everything over before it goes up. This is a curated shelf, not an open upload door: digital products only, nothing illegal, nothing pirated, no adult material, no money schemes, and you must own what you're selling. I can refuse or remove any listing — my name's on the store.

One honest note: I'm selling shelf space, not promising traffic or sales. Folks who find this store will see your products right alongside mine. What they buy is up to them.

Verkäuferplätze bald verfügbar — E-Mail an wadebrower792@gmail.com
